title: TEAMESSENTIAL+
description: The ultimate teammate mod — glow, coord sharing, SOS alerts, direction arrows, Discord webhooks, and more for teams, teammates, friends.
body:
# TeamEssential+

The all-in-one teammate mod for Minecraft. Stay connected with your squad on any server.

## Features

### 🤝 Teammate System
- Send team requests to other players via whisper protocol — no server mod needed
- Accept or decline requests through the in-game GUI
- Per-server teammate lists — different teammates for different servers
- Removing a teammate syncs for both players automatically

### ✨ Teammate Glow
- Teammates glow on your screen with a colored outline (client-side only)
- Toggle glow on/off for all teammates
- Choose whether YOU glow on your teammates' screens
- Respects teammate preferences — if they disable glow, you won't see them glow

### 📍 HUD Overlay
- Live coordinate display for you and nearby teammates
- Green/red status indicators (online/offline)
- Shows last known coords when teammates go out of render distance
- Nether/End coordinate translation
- Distance to each teammate in blocks
- Dimension-colored accent bar (cyan = Overworld, orange = Nether, purple = End)
- Fully draggable and resizable —

User must need mod in order to use.
